invariants.rationale: The incoming parameter isChecked indicates the target checked state, and the method is likely used to update the button checked status.
It is also possible isChecked could be false, representing the button is being set to unchecked; enumerating both possibilities may help analysis.
fireEvent being true suggests the caller wants to fire a change event when toggling the button state.
If fireEvent is false, the caller likely wants to change the checked state silently.
If isChecked is true and fireEvent is false, then only the checked state should update without event firing; this may help characterize method contracts.
